export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1

SCRIPT="/root/entrainment_gated_ft/run_lmeval_clean.py"
OUTDIR="/root/entrainment_gated_ft/lm_eval_clean"
TASKS="lambada_openai,hellaswag,winogrande,piqa,arc_easy,arc_challenge,mmlu"
BS=16

MODELS=(
    "1.3B-100B-RetNet-pure"
    "transformer_1.3B_baseline"
    "1.3B-100B-GatedDeltaNet-hybrid-3-1"
    "1.3B-100B-GatedDeltaNet-hybrid-6-1"
    "1.3B-100B-GatedDeltaNet-hybrid-12-1"
    "1.3B-100B-GatedDeltaNet-hybrid-24-1"
    "1.3B-100B-GatedDeltaNet-pure"
)

for m in "${MODELS[@]}"; do
    MPATH="/root/autodl-tmp/models_1.3b/$m"
    OUTFILE="$OUTDIR/$m.json"
    if [ -f "$OUTFILE" ]; then
        echo "=== SKIP $m (already exists) ==="
        continue
    fi
    echo ""
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "  Running: $m"
    echo "  Time: $(date)"
    echo "=========================================="
    python "$SCRIPT" --model_path "$MPATH" --tasks "$TASKS" --output_dir "$OUTDIR" --batch_size "$BS"
    rc=$?
    echo "Exit code: $rc, Time: $(date)"
    if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
        echo "ERROR: $m failed with exit code $rc"
    fi
done

echo ""
echo "=========================================="
echo "  ALL DONE at $(date)"
echo "=========================================="
SCRIPT_EOF
chmod +x /root/entrainment_gated_ft/run_all_eval.sh
echo "Script written"
